name: rtk_2026-09-29
label: INDEPENDENT
why: RTK check shots of 29 Sep 2026 (the user first called the date 27 Sep): not used by the calibration (GCPs of 13 Nov 2025), the search envelope (the live detector's own, from hand-clicked ground truth) or the water level (GNSS-R). INDEPENDENT only for a build whose setup coefficient was fitted to other data or to none (C = 0, or --setup-coef with --setup-fitted-to): the station's C = 0.037 was fitted to these very shots (survey_products.py SETUP_FITS), so with it the setup rule makes this comparison CIRCULAR, recognised by content, name, coordinates or date; it then cannot test the setup or the overall level of the lines. The transects start at ~+1.2 m: the waterline check covers the upper beach only (~+1.0 to +1.6 m). An independent check of the whole intertidal needs another survey that fitted nothing, e.g. a calm low-tide RTK across it.
